name: Fallen Scavenger
design: Small hunched horned imp, wiry limbs, chipped cleaver, scrap-wood buckler, muddy red-brown hide and ragged leather. Cowardly melee swarm; crouched asymmetric silhouette.

name: Fallen Ash Shaman
design: Small elderly horned demon, stooped spine, tall crooked staff with a modest ember and bone charms, soot-stained hide, ragged mantle. Staff and posture clearly distinguish resurrection caster from melee.

name: Drowned Fieldhand
design: Human-sized former farm worker, sagging shoulders, dragging leg, torn wool and rope belt, cold grey skin with mud stains. One malformed stiff arm; restrained decay, no exposed entrails.

name: Grave Hunger
design: Emaciated human undead, forward-thrust neck, long grasping arms, burial wraps and clotted earth, sunken grey face. Lean reaching silhouette distinct from shambling fieldhand.

name: Moor Quill Rat
design: Low quadruped rodent with wedge head, fan of coarse dark spines on back, muddy olive-grey hide, short digging claws. Ranged animal threat; natural animal with only exaggerated spine launcher.

name: Thornback Fiend
design: Stocky boar-rat-like quadruped, shoulders form a broad triangular quill ridge, coarse brown-black pelt, worn ivory spines. Distinguish from Quill Rat through heavier shoulders and longer muzzle.

name: Briarback Brute
design: Large ape-like forest brute, massive shoulders and forearms, short powerful legs, weathered brown fur with small matted patches, flattened predatory face. No armor or giant weapons; heavy knuckle-driven melee.

name: Ashwood Wendigo
design: Tall gaunt furred humanoid brute, long arms, narrow waist, hunched pointed shoulder silhouette and pale dirty fur, believable muscular joints. D2 ape-like family, no deer skull or antlers from modern folklore.

name: Oathbroken Hunter
design: Adult corrupted rogue melee fighter with practical torn leather armor and faded cloth, single rusted short sword, hostile forward stance, subtly ashen skin. Former disciplined soldier, no pinup styling.

name: Widow Bow Rogue
design: Adult fallen rogue archer, long battered bow, narrow bent-knee stance, worn hood pushed back, damaged grey leather armor, faded burgundy cloth. Bow-ready posture and clear string/limb silhouette.

name: Briar Spear Rogue
design: Adult corrupted rogue spearwoman, two-handed long spear, low braced stance, patched leather and rusty iron shoulder guard. Grounded martial proportions, no ornate armor, distinguish role by weapon and stance.

name: Ossuary Watchman
design: Human skeleton foot soldier, dirt-stained ivory bones, remnants of rusted mail and broken nasal helmet, chipped sword and small battered shield. Broad readable bone masses; no excessive tiny bone ornaments.

name: Crypt Bowguard
design: Human skeletal archer, long wooden bow, ragged burial cloth around pelvis, broken leather bracer, bone-grey skull with no decorative glow. Slight lateral stance showing bow and ribcage clearly.

name: Cinder Ossuary Mage
design: Human skeleton caster with scorched robe remnants, bent ritual staff and a tiny controlled amber fire in one hand. Thin tall silhouette, dirty ivory and charcoal palette; fire only as a small meaningful accent.

name: Carrion Blood Hawk
design: Carrion raptor with ragged broad wings, hooked beak, sparse rust-brown plumage over grey leathery neck. Folded-wing perching and wings-open attack poses; readable game-scale wing shape.

name: Churchyard Foul Crow
design: Lean demonic scavenger bird, narrow hooked head, long primary feathers, crooked talons, black-brown plumage with muted dried-blood accents. Corruption focused in bare neck and beak; no giant fantasy horns.

name: Stonefield Goat Raider
design: Goat-legged humanoid raider, coarse dark fur, compact curved horns, rough leather straps, chipped two-handed axe and salvaged iron guards. Hooved legs, axe silhouette, grounded tribal scavenger design.

name: Moon Clan Bonecaller
design: Goat-legged humanoid caster, backward-curving horns, long narrow staff, ragged hide mantle and sparse bone charms. Reserved muted umber/olive palette, pale ash markings; no glowing decorative runes.

name: Catacomb Tainted
design: Stocky crouched bipedal demon, broad low head, thick hunched shoulders, short heavy legs, muted plum-brown leathery skin and a narrow maw suitable for spitting a small lightning attack. Distinct squat silhouette, no giant VFX.

name: Cloister Crypt Weaver
design: Large low crypt spider with eight anatomically coherent legs, broad dark abdomen, coarse grey-brown carapace, sparse hairs and small dull eyes. Web hints only at feet; spider anatomy readable without exaggerated fluorescent poison sacs.
